local_corrections: Kept six perspectives distinct from stages, ranks and guarantees; separated wavering between occurrences from interchangeability in one occurrence.
Required actual words or effects reaching the beloved before assigning an outward interpersonal direction to private expectations.
Clarified mistaken judgment versus deception, self-acknowledgment versus ownership, and exclusivity as an explicit source position rather than a deduction from respect alone.

Distinguished obstacles, broken promises, silently abandoned undertakings and acknowledged departure; preserved original applicable conditions and safe, intelligible exit without demanding permission or unlimited explanations.
Retained Casablanca's open question of entrusted judgment and later objection; followed Waller's novel rather than the film in The Bridges of Madison County.
Removed an unsupported expansion of unresolved AI bearer questions to fictional characters.
Repaired English pronoun ambiguity and several unnatural formulations; corrected Traditional Chinese names and contextual forms including 亞里士多德, 舍勒, 里克, 髮色 and 反覆 without changing 日復一日.
